E1004

Unknown item in core module

What

Unknown item in core module

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E1004

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1004: tests/ui/core_submodule_item_path.stderr.

Error [E1004]: `core.crypto` has no item `uuid`
  --> tests/ui/core_submodule_item_path.jet:4:17
    |
  4 |     _ :: crypto.uuid()
    |                 ^^^^
 Why: Core is one nested tree, so a name under this module can belong to a submodule instead of the module itself
 Fix: `core.crypto.uuid` is a submodule, so name an item on it: `core.crypto.uuid.v4`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1004

Error [E1004]: `core.crypto` has no item `v4`
  --> tests/ui/core_submodule_item_path.jet:5:17
    |
  5 |     _ :: crypto.v4()
    |                 ^^
 Why: Core is one nested tree, so a name under this module can belong to a submodule instead of the module itself
 Fix: `v4` lives in the submodule `core.crypto.uuid`, so write `core.crypto.uuid.v4`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1004
